rationale: Independent reading before the producer rationale: held EO 7845 (3 FR 715) is the 1938 annual-leave regulations, secs. 1-22, no own term (sec. 21 is an effective-date clause). Held EO 8384 (5 FR 1253, signed Mar. 29, 1940, [No. 8384]) is the replacement annual-leave regulations; sec. 21: 'This order shall supersede Executive Orders No. 7845 of March 21, 1938, No. 7879 of May 9, 1938, and No. 8226 of August 24, 1939, and shall be effective as of March 2, 1940, except that sections 6 and 9 shall be effective as of July 1, 1936 ...'. Whole-order supersession by number; the proviso limits EO 8384's own retroactive sections, not a savings clause for 7845; sec. 20 only ratifies departmental temporary regulations. My status: NO. The OFR '(in part)' qualifier is contradicted by the held text. D6: later events are EO 7879/7880 (sec. 6) and EO 8226 (sec. 15) amendments, all before and all superseded in the same sec. 21; EO 8385 (sick leave) carries an identical-looking sec. 21 only because the held page extract overlaps 8384 - it is a companion order, not a different end. A grep of all held full-run texts for 7845 finds only hash/page-number noise outside 7845/7846/7879/7880/8226/8384/8385; no revival, extension or earlier end. Accept.
